release_notes:
Trust an exact username match as much as an exact email match for auto-create

The auto-create-new-invoice path for an unsolicited Zelle deposit only trusted an
exact email match in the memo, not an exact username match, even though usernames
are just as unique per account as emails are. A deposit memo naming the customer's
username but citing an amount with no matching pending invoice (or an old, already-
closed invoice number) had no path to get credited automatically and needed manual
admin intervention every time.
